decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several high-performing speakers from reputable brands like Bose and JBL, as well as unique aesthetic and budget options. I narrowed my selection to products with strong rating consistency and high review volumes. The JBL Clip 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_147) was chosen as the final purchase because it offers the best balance of portability, proven durability (waterproof and rugged design), and an extremely high user rating (4.7) at a significantly lower price point ($54.95) than the Bose SoundLink Color II ($124.95).
